$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Pass sheet
job: The pass of one person, opened over the booking: whether it is valid, whose it is, and the code to show at the gate.
useFor: Any pass, permit or ticket shown to a person or a scanner.
notFor: A pass that is itself a full card with photo (use Pass viewer).

forbidden: Opening as a new page that loses the booking.

allowed: One StatusChip in words: active, not yet active, used, expired, cancelled.
forbidden: A valid-looking code with a non-valid status.

allowed: Name and the identifiers the gate checks.
forbidden: Identifiers the gate does not need.

allowed: QRCodeStatus at a size that scans, with an optional label for the pass type and its meaning one tap away.
forbidden: A label with no stated meaning.
A code that needs the network to render.

allowed: Share, and add to wallet with the official wallet artwork.
forbidden: Share on a pass that is not valid.

states.changes: Code shown or held back by service rule; the time it becomes active is stated.
No code; the status and what to do next.
The last saved pass if there is one, and a retry (SectionError); never an empty sheet.

rules: Validity is the first thing read.
The code is never cropped, dimmed or covered.
Digits 0–9; Arabic and English both checked.

allocation.App level: L4 · an artefact. Opened from the person card, from the request card on Today, and from the notification.
allocation.Band: Band 2; band 1 at the gate. Promoted to P1 at the moment of use.
allocation.Offline: Available offline once issued; brightness raised while open.
allocation.Withheld: A person opens only their own pass, or those of people they booked for.

measure.success: Pass opened at the gate without retry

notes: Built on Bottom Sheet · Status=Default with QR Code · Type=Prioirty.
example.inTheFlowToday: The code carries a "privilege card" label with an info icon and no stated meaning on the sheet.
